{"findings":[{"rule_id":"MX-012","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D4","page":1,"quote":"⌀7"}],"comment":"The part is titled 'LOCATING PIN' and note N3 specifies case hardening, indicating the pin diameter (D4) is a functional locating feature, yet it carries no tolerance of its own and falls back to the general ±0.2 mm. A locating pin requires a tight, explicitly toleranced diameter to function; the designer should add an appropriate fit tolerance to D4."
  , "recommended_correction": "Add a specific tolerance to dimension D4 suitable for a locating pin."}]}
